name: Nationality by Naturalisation (Grant)

requirements.blocker_text: 20 years of continuous legal residence in Oman.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 20 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: A clean criminal record is required.
A reduced 10-year continuous residence requirement applies to nationals of Arab countries, alongside the same Arabic-language, income, and conduct conditions as the general track.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of continuous legal residence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous legal residence (10 or 20 years)

sources.title: Commoner Law -- Oman naturalisation requirements under Royal Decree 38/2014 (replacing RD 3/1983): 20 years' continuous residence for non-Arab nationals, 10 years for Arab nationals, Arabic proficiency, lawful income, clean criminal record, discretionary Royal Decree approval, no dual nationality permitted

Decree.om -- corroborates the 20-year general/naturalisation timeline and separately notes a 15-year reduced residence figure described for applicants married to an Omani woman, distinct from the dedicated marriage-based citizenship route

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Oman). STATUS: DRAFT -- primary legislative text (Royal Decree 38/2014) could not be independently fetched (robots.txt/SSL errors on the Official Gazette PDF across repeated attempts); relies on two corroborating tier-3 legal-commentary sources for the 20-year/10-year figures. One of the two sources additionally describes a 15-year reduced-residence figure for (male) applicants married to an Omani woman, which was NOT modeled as a separate hard requirement here since it wasn't independently corroborated by the second source and risked conflating two distinct provisions (Arab-nationality reduction vs. marriage-based reduction) -- disclosed as a gap rather than guessed at. Discretionary: meeting the listed conditions makes an applicant eligible to apply, not automatically entitled to a grant -- naturalisation is by Royal Decree. dual_citizenship_allowed modeled FALSE; Oman does not permit dual nationality, and naturalisation requires renouncing prior citizenship. Oman has no separate 'permanent residence' status distinct from these citizenship routes -- long-term non-citizen residents (including Golden/Silver Visa holders) renew their residence status indefinitely rather than progressing through an intermediate PR tier.
